aiAssistant.inputPlaceholder: Ask the AI assistant a question...
aiAssistant.welcomeMessage:
👋 Hello! I'm your AI assistant for family management.

✨ I can help you:
• Create interesting tasks for children
• Give motivation tips
• Set up a reward system
• Analyze progress

Choose a topic below or ask your own question!
aiAssistant.mockResponse:
Thanks for the question! 💡

Based on your request "{query}", here are my recommendations:

✅ **Start small**
Create 2-3 tasks per day to avoid overwhelming the child

🎯 **Vary the difficulty**
Alternate between easy and hard tasks to maintain interest

📊 **Regular check-ins**
Track progress weekly and adjust your approach

🏆 **Instant rewards**
Reward achievements immediately for better motivation

Want to learn more about any of these points?
